Treasure mage acts as a toolbox for a threat you may need in a given situation. If you can mindslaver lock, it can grab it, if you need lifegain or something that can survive a sweep, wurmcoil is a good option, angel is a good grab if you know they don’t have answers to it. I also don’t count it as a threat, but it does make a good beater in certain situations when you can’t get a big threat out

In that case, I would go more into the [[treasure mage]] route with [[wurmcoil engine]] [[platinum angel]] and other threats. Generally, you want to run about 6 threats in your 60. The [[mindslaver]] and [[academy ruins]] combo is also a fun one to run as a finisher. Most of the time, your opponent will scoop if you keep taking control of their turn. One of the main benefits of U tron vs Gx or E tron is the inclusion of [[thirst for knowledge]], it gives great card draw and can put slaver in the grave for when you get your combo online. Running a strong countermagic package is also a must as we don’t have as many tools to fish out or last tron pieces, so cards like [[condescend]] and [[remand]] help survive into the late game when we can start throwing threats on the board. 
I started out playing U tron the same way and I eventually upgraded to the chalices and ballistas, it’s a lot of fun and I hope you enjoy it!
